pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/meta.rs:1422 GET /apps marks an app ready when all its declared Requirements hold, but Requirement has only an Env variant (crates/core/src/app.rs:1302-1306) and the default requires() is empty. So Claude-cost apps such as research (cost_class Claude at crates/apps/research/src/lib.rs:488, no requires override) show ready: true without proving the claude binary is installed or authorized. That turns an unknown into a confident yes, which is the failure availability-probe names.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/meta.rs:1422 The readiness verdict is only env-var presence. No probe for installed/version/authorized and no unknown state. A repo-wide search found no `--version`, `auth status` or `fn probe` for the claude engine.
